selection_policy.papers: two questions from each verified benchmark paper (paper-001 through paper-010)
selection_policy.gold_isolation: Gold answers and evidence are not loaded by the Q&A execution script.

category_definitions.factual: Requires a grounded statement of a paper's problem, method, focus, or conceptual relation.
category_definitions.numeric: Requires preserving at least one material number or named quantitative setting from the evidence.
category_definitions.comparison: Requires relating alternatives, configurations, trade-offs, datasets, or baselines.
category_definitions.limitation: Requires recognizing a stated problem boundary, assumption, guarantee boundary, or qualified conclusion.
